security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://thetadata.net https://www.thetadata.net; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: TdDx Store is the queue-driven dataset downloader for ThetaData. Browse a curated catalogue of stock + option datasets (trades, NBBO quotes, OHLC, EOD, greeks, open interest), queue downloads, watch live progress, persist to parquet/csv/jsonl. Cross-platform desktop app + companion CLI.
